title: English darts player Beau Greaves becomes first woman to win PDC ranking title
content:
Beau Greaves has become the first woman to win a PDC ranking title after beating Michael Smith in the Players Championship 11 final on Monday.

The Englishwoman, 22, beat former world champions in each of the last three rounds, seeing off Rob Cross in the quarter-final and Gary Anderson in the semi-final before her 8-7 victory over Smith, and will earn £15,000 for the achievement.

The Players Championship 11 is a regular tour event — one rung below the majors and the European Tour.

Greaves averaged 96.49 in the final, after

“I can’t believe it,” she said, via Oche180. “I was up a fair few legs and I started to think about it. It caught up with me.

“I don’t know if I thought about being the first woman to do one. I can’t believe I hit that. I can’t believe I took out that.

“I have had a great year but I would never have thought I would win one.

“I’m beating players that I watched growing up. It is just amazing and I am really proud of myself to win one of these.”

Greaves is a three-time women’s world champion and made her debut at the prestigious PDC world championship in 2022, aged 18, losing to William O’Connor in the first round. She was one of five women who competed at the 2026 PDC world championship — a record for the event.

The Players Championship 11 only permits Tour Card holders, of which there are 128 at any one time.
